Staff Vacancy (updated)
Wednesday, 26 May 2021
8431 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram invites applications for the following posts. The applications on plain paper enclosing the complete bio-data, certified photocopies of the academic and experience certificates must reach to the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, PO. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha - 442 102 latest by
05/07/2021
.
1)
Administrative Officer-1 (SC category)
Qualification & Experience
: Must be a Graduate in Science/Arts/ Commerce/Law of an Indian University or equivalent, person with Master in Business Administration or degree/diploma in Health Administration will be preferred & must have at least ten years’ experience of administration and supervision with five years’ experience in a large multi-specialty hospital with 500 beds.  Has to assist Senior Officers in all administrative work, handle legal matters and should have a very good communication skill in English in writing as well as speaking and should have knowledge of computers and have proficiency in Marathi.
2)
Assistant Engineer (Electrical)-1 (Open category)
Qualification & Experience
: Should be B.E. (Electrical) from a recognized Indian University.  Should possess outstanding academic record and should have worked in the field in a reputed organization for at least 10 years out of which 5 years should be in a Medical College/ Hospital with 500 beds or more.
Salary:
As admissible under the rules of Kasturba Health Society.
Age
: Upper age limit 38 years for open category and 43 years for reserved category.
The Selection Committee at its discretion, may shortlist the applicants for interview based on experience and/or higher qualification etc. OR may conduct written screening test to shortlist the candidates for interview.
Age and experience can be relaxed for exceptional and deserving candidate. Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
Note : Those who had applied in reference to our earlier advertisement dated 26/05/2021, need not to apply again.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
